**The sixth release candidate.** It ships inside [HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.5](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-rc.5) and needs HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.3 or newer. On the older Hyundai models running 260903, update HMG-API to 1.1.0-rc.5 too: their hook map is new there.

## What's new since 2.2.0-rc.5

- **The older Hyundai models, US and Canada** (#78): Elantra (and Hybrid), Sonata (and Hybrid), Santa Fe (and Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid), Kona, Kona Electric 2020-21, Ioniq (Electric, Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid), Venue 2020-22, Veloster N and Palisade 2020-22, on US 260507, Canada 260206 and US/Canada 260903.
  - These cars have the Wi-Fi chip but no stock hotspot, so their Car Reports say Wi-Fi "unpowered". Until now the mod refused them, even with **Install anyway**.
  - The mod now turns on their stock wireless CarPlay and Android Auto, plus HMG-API's hotspot. No app file is replaced.
  - Cluster turn-by-turn comes along where an existing library patch fits the car's library: Android Auto on Canada 260206 and 260903, and CarPlay on 260903. US 260507 has no Android Auto turn-by-turn yet.
- **Hyundai Ioniq 5 (`NEEV`) on Canada 260903** (#77): it has the same files as the US 260903 build and uses its set.

## What to test

- **On one of the older Hyundai models, before anything else:** after Apply and a restart, does the hotspot come up (the phone sees the car's Wi-Fi) and does wireless CarPlay or Android Auto connect? Nobody has run this on a car yet. A Car Report afterwards shows whether the chip powered on (`wifi`).
- **Canadian Ioniq 5 on 260903:** wireless CarPlay and Android Auto, with turn-by-turn.
- Cars that worked on rc.5 should work as before.

## Known issues

- Not checked on any of the older Hyundai models yet. If the hotspot doesn't come up there, please send a Car Report (HMG-API app → Car Report).
- The cluster's route-guidance watchdog (#51) and the Bluetooth Audio focus fix (#56) are as in rc.5.
